note: Headline additional US tariff on most goods of each country, in percent, in force on each date (12:01 a.m. US Eastern). Adds up the country-wide measures only: IEEPA 'fentanyl' duties (EO 14193 Canada, 14194 Mexico, 14195 China, as amended by EO 14228, 14231/14232, 14325, 14357), IEEPA reciprocal tariffs (EO 14257 of 2 Apr 2025, FR 2025-06063, 10% baseline from 5 Apr, Annex I rates from 9 Apr; EO 14259 China 84% on 9 Apr; EO 14266 pause and China 125% from 10 Apr; EO 14298 China 10% from 14 May; EO 14326 Annex I rates from 7 Aug 2025, FR 2025-15010; Switzerland and Liechtenstein 15% from 14 Nov 2025, FR 2025-23316), Brazil +40% (EO 14323, from 6 Aug 2025), India +25% for Russian oil (EO 14329, from 27 Aug 2025; ended 7 Feb 2026 by EO 14384), then, after the Supreme Court ruled on 20 Feb 2026 (Learning Resources v. Trump) that IEEPA does not authorise tariffs, CBP stopped collecting all IEEPA duties from 24 Feb 2026 (EO 14389; CSMS 67834313) and a 10% Section 122 surcharge applied to all countries 24 Feb-24 Jul 2026 (Proclamation 11012, FR 2026-03824; CSMS 67844987; an announced rise to 15% was never proclaimed). From 22 Jul 2026 Section 301 adds 25% on Brazil (USTR FR 2026-14542) and from 24 Jul 2026 Section 301 'forced labour' tariffs of 10% or 12.5% apply to 60 economies (memorandum FR 2026-15274, USTR notice FR 2026-15181); other countries then pay no country-wide extra tariff. Not included: sector tariffs under Section 232 (steel, aluminium, copper, cars, trucks, lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors...), older Section 301 tariffs on China (7.5-100%), Section 338 duties on some Canadian goods (from 22 Aug 2026), product exemptions (e.g. energy, many farm goods from 14 Nov 2025, EO 14360) and the USMCA exemption that covers most goods from Canada and Mexico. EU (from 7 Aug 2025), Japan, South Korea and Switzerland (from 14 Nov 2025): the rate is 'all-in', i.e. includes the normal MFN duty; the 2026 Section 301 rates for the EU, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Switzerland are likewise net of MFN. Hong Kong and Macau take China's rates. Russia, Belarus, Cuba and North Korea (column-2 countries, outside the reciprocal tariffs) are not shown. Liechtenstein after 24 Jul 2026 is left blank. 'announced' = Annex I of EO 14257 (57 partners, EU as one; everyone else 10%). 'deficit' = (US imports - US exports) / US imports, 2024, Census FT-900 data as published 6 Mar 2025 (archived copy of census.gov/foreign-trade/balance/country.xlsx, 10 Mar 2025). 'formula' = max(10, deficit rounded to a whole percent, halved and rounded up), the USTR method (ustr.gov 'Reciprocal Tariff Calculations': rate = deficit / (4 x 0.25 x imports)) halved per EO 14257: it reproduces 82 of 84 Annex I rates exactly (EU members counted individually) and the rest within 1 point (JPN, VNM).
